_doc: Desert sand ground (bead bzc.88, docs/art/classes/grounds.md). Lessons of grounds-volcanic: no chibi style layer (it turns a field into a character), never the words texture or tile (pixen draws a paving grid), a long-period base from pixflux at 400 x 400 (5 cells). Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead. '@name' values come from shared.

shared.base: Subject: a wide flat field of golden desert sand seen from directly above, filling the whole image edge to edge: warm golden sand #dcb46c with soft, long, gently curving wind ripples in slightly lighter #e8c684 and slightly darker #c99e5a stripes, the ripples wavy and broken, running in many slightly different directions, a few tiny scattered pebbles, very calm, quiet and low in contrast, the same everywhere.
shared.dunes: Subject: rolling golden desert dunes seen from straight above, filling the whole image edge to edge: smooth warm golden sand #dcb46c, broad soft lighter #e8c684 crests and slightly darker #c99e5a hollows, fine wavy wind ripples over them, a few tiny scattered pebbles, very calm and low in contrast, no single big dune, the same everywhere.
